title: 第11章 呦呵这不就来活了嘛第12章 这真的是他们之前那个师姐吗
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 因为觉得原身课堂没人听，第二天林筱什么都没准备，不，准备了个枕头，打算拿到教室里睡觉。
结果她一推开门，齐刷刷的目光向她看来。
她走错地方了？
于是众弟子就看到他们的大师姐后退着离开讲堂，看了看讲堂上方的牌匾，然后迈着沉重的步伐再次走进讲堂。
在所有人的注视下走到最前方的蒲团上坐下，林筱内心已经不是慌得一批，而是慌得好几批了。
不是，说好最不受欢迎女亲传呢！
是谁偷偷改了她的背景人设！
林筱很快看到了罪魁祸首。
满屋几乎都是女修士，她们无一例外都痴痴盯着一个地方。
她顺着她们的视线看过去，一个青年对她微微展露笑颜，林筱仿佛在青年周边看到了绿柳微风，带来无尽的温柔惬意。
林筱保证，她听到了吸凉气的声音。
岳子舒！
他怎么在这儿？
别跟她说他是来听课的，他一个元婴修士跑来听她一个金丹修士讲课，那不是倒反天罡吗！
岳子舒仿佛看穿了林筱内心，轻轻一笑：“修行不能全按修为论事，凡间都有不耻下问的道理，修者自然更要以达者为先，我虽为元婴修士，但仍在一些方面不如大师姐，还望大师姐不吝赐教。”
岳子舒说了这么一大堆，在林筱耳中听来就是，对，我就是来捣乱的，你能怎么办吧？
好好好。
林筱面无表情，“哪些方面？”
岳子舒一愣，“嗯？”
“你不是说有一些方面不如我吗，我问你，哪些方面？”
今天他要是回答不上来，看她怎么蹂躏他！
别以为元婴修士就了不起，落她手里，照收拾不误！
岳子舒沉默片刻，道：“比如说，大师姐的教具就很独特，如此新颖的教具定然能为课堂增添乐趣，这是子舒不如师姐的地方。”
教具？
满讲堂弟子不约而同看向林筱手里的枕头，然后疑惑的抬头，等待林筱解释。
她要是说她是觉得没人来所以拿枕头来睡觉的，能不把她踢出天衍宗吗？
就在这时，门外再次走来一人。
“好多人啊，是以宁来晚了吗？”
温以宁一进讲堂，一股药香随之涌入，众弟子不由得深吸一口气，霎时觉得神清气爽，整个人都精神了许多。
“是三师姐！”
“三师姐出关了？什么时候，我怎么不知道。”
“啊啊啊！
我女神，这我女神！”
“天，我要把这件事告诉全宗！”
全场沸腾，所有弟子起身对着温以宁行鞠躬礼，“三师姐。”
温以宁浅笑，“师弟师妹们不必多礼，请起吧。”
她刚想找个空地方坐着，目光无意间从左前方扫过，顿时一愣，“二师兄？”
岳子舒对着温以宁笑笑：“三师妹好久不见了，你已经突破金丹五重了？”
温以宁面露惊喜，“二师兄你什么时候回来的，也不说一声。”
岳子舒道：“昨日刚回来，先去了大长老那里，还没来得及去看你。”
温以宁没有犹豫走到岳子舒身旁坐下，“你们都出去历练了，就我一个人待在宗门闭关，如果还突破不了金丹五重，我干脆找块豆腐撞死得了。”
岳子舒被逗笑，“以师妹金丹五重修为，这次宗门大比排名定然会上升一大截。”
“那以宁就借师兄吉言了。”
content_en:
Because she felt that no one was listening in class, Lin Xiao didn't prepare anything the next day. No, she prepared a pillow and planned to take it to the classroom to sleep.
As a result, as soon as she opened the door, all eyes looked at her.
Lin Xiao: "..."
Is she in the wrong place?
Then the disciples saw their senior sister retreating from the lecture hall, looked at the plaque above the lecture hall, and then walked into the lecture hall again with heavy steps.
After walking to the front futon and sitting down under everyone's gaze, Lin Xiao felt not only panicked, but panicked several times.
No, we agreed to be the least popular biography of a daughter!
Who secretly changed her background design?
Lin Xiao quickly saw the culprit.
The room was almost full of female monks, and without exception, they all stared at the same place.
She followed their gaze and saw a young man smiling slightly at her. Lin Xiao seemed to see the green willow breeze around the young man, bringing endless tenderness and comfort.
Lin Xiao assured that she heard the sound of breathing cold air.
Yue Zishu!
Why is he here?
Don't tell her that he is here to listen to a lecture. If he, a Nascent Soul monk, comes to listen to her lectures, a Golden elixir monk, isn't that going against Tiangang?
Yue Zishu seemed to have seen through Lin Xiao's heart, and smiled softly: "Practice cannot be judged solely on the basis of cultivation. There is a principle in the world of not being ashamed to ask questions. Naturally, cultivators must put masters first. Although I am a Nascent Soul monk, I am still not as good as Senior Sister in some aspects. I hope Senior Sister will not hesitate to give me some advice."
Yue Zishu said so much, it sounded to Lin Xiao's ears like, yes, I'm just here to cause trouble, what can you do?
OK OK.
Lin Xiao's face was expressionless, "In which aspects?"
Yue Zishu was stunned, "Huh?"
"Didn't you say that you are not as good as me in some aspects? Let me ask you, which aspects?"
If he can't answer today, let's see how she ravages him!
Don't think that the Nascent Soul cultivator is so great. If it falls into her hands, she will take care of it!
Yue Zishu was silent for a moment and said: "For example, senior sister's teaching aids are very unique. Such novel teaching aids will definitely add fun to the class. This is where Zishu is inferior to senior sister."
Teaching aids?
All the disciples in the lecture hall looked at the pillow in Lin Xiao's hand, then raised their heads in confusion, waiting for Lin Xiao's explanation.
Lin Xiao: "..."
If she said that she thought no one would come so she used a pillow to sleep on, could she not be kicked out of the Tianyan Sect?
At this moment, another person walked outside the door.
"There are so many people. Did Yining come late?"
As soon as Wen Yining entered the lecture hall, a scent of medicine rushed in. All the disciples couldn't help but take a deep breath. They felt refreshed and energetic.
"It's Third Senior Sister!"
"Third Senior Sister came out of seclusion? Why didn't I know when?"
“Ahhh!
My goddess, this my goddess! "
"God, I want to tell the entire clan about this!"
The whole place was filled with excitement. All the disciples stood up and bowed to Wen Yining, "Third Senior Sister."
Wen Yining smiled slightly, "Junior brothers and sisters, there is no need to be polite, please get up."
She was just about to find an empty place to sit when her eyes inadvertently glanced from the left front and she was stunned, "Second Senior Brother?"
Yue Zishu smiled at Wen Yining: "Third junior sister, we haven't seen you for a long time. Have you already broken through the fifth level of the golden elixir?"
Wen Yining looked surprised, "Second Senior Brother, you didn't tell me when you came back."
Yue Zishu said: "I just came back yesterday. I went to the great elder first, but I didn't have time to see you."
Wen Yining walked over to Yue Zishu and sat down without hesitation, "You have all gone out to practice. I am the only one staying in the sect's retreat. If I still can't break through the fifth level of the golden elixir, I might as well find a piece of tofu and kill me."
Yue Zishu was amused, "With my junior sister's level 5 Golden Core cultivation, her ranking in this sect competition will definitely rise a lot."
"Then Yi Ning will borrow the good words from senior brother."
title_en: Chapter 11 Oh, isn’t it time to live? Chapter 12 Is this really the senior sister from before?
